works.body:
Hello! I'm back again with another request! This time, I'd like to request a chibi piece with my 原神 OC Yuelin and the NPC Zhongli.

For the setting, I would like them to be picking Qingxin flowers together on top of the mountains (maybe Mt. Hulao? Generic Liyue mountains will work too.). Yuelin is kneeling to pick some more flowers while Zhongli is watching over her affectionately while holding a bunch of Qingxin in his arms. But feel free to go with an alternative pose set that may fit better.

Thank you for your time and consideration! And thank you for your fantastic art as always!

Yuelin [月林] reference: https://imgur.com/a/HMxjaeg
Zhongli [钟离] reference: https://imgur.com/a/pVzNYRA

https://imgur.com/a/HMxjaeg

Hello! I love your artwork very much! I'd like to make a request. I'd like to request artwork of Albedo from Genshin Impact and my character together. (Character Reference: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/17a-MHWUHk3yXj2fr18SZqLKt3waez5PU  ) I'd like the concept to be something sweet and charming, and for Albedo to be very prince-like. I’ll leave it up to your interpretation. 

Thank you for your consideration.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/17a-MHWUHk3yXj2fr18SZqLKt3waez5PU

Hello! I'm dropping in with another request, if that's okay! Once again, I'd like to request a chibi piece with my 原神 OC Seline and the NPC Diluc (ディルック).

For the pose, could I request Diluc giving Seline a bouquet of roses and a heart-shaped box of chocolates? He would be very bashful about it so I imagine he would have a blushing face.
Seline is very aware that he's very shy about relationships and public displays of affection. So I think she would have a gentle smiling face. Her cheeks would be flushed pink because she is happy.

I will leave the background details to you, but maybe this could be during the Windblume festival? Feel free to pick a different background if it's easier.

Thank you for your time and consideration! Thank you for the fantastic art as always!

Seline reference: https://imgur.com/a/xvrkoo0
Diluc reference: https://imgur.com/a/nHe351T

Festival/background reference: https://imgur.com/a/QSt6Svs

https://imgur.com/a/xvrkoo0

Hello!

I absolutely love your art style, it's so cute and would like to request art of my Vtuber! I will be using it for SNS (twitter, twitch, youtube, etc). I included my reference via the link, along with a close up of my main model. Feel free to choose the pose/expression! If you could add a background, that'd be great!

Bee is a friendly star guardian elf from space, she's charismatic, elegant, and a goofball at times! She enjoys star gazing, practicing her magic, drinking tea and reading, playing with her magical cat, and going on new adventures!

I would to also request a psd/transparent file.
Thank you for your consideration!!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-PmOC47OspXXs5nqm1Wa-IXy6AciVJ6c?usp=sharing

Hello! I really loved the chibi work you did for me before! I would like to request another chibi drawing of my 原神 OC Seline and the NPC Diluc (ディルック). This time, Seline will be in her alternate outfit. 

I would like the setting to be during the lantern rite festival in Liyue. I will let you pick what they are doing. Maybe have them strolling around holding hands, or releasing lanterns together? I would like their expressions to be happy or loving.

Hello, my name is Miyu Rurizuki, and I am a Vtuber.
I think your cute illustrations are wonderful and I would be very happy to commission them from you.
I will celebrate my birthday on January 23rd, and I was hoping to give my listeners a celebration as a net print.
I was wondering if you could create an illustration of the image for me to give to my listeners as an online print.

Purpose of use
Thumbnail of Youtube video and use in the video
For online printing
We will register for free online printing at Seven-Eleven, FamilyMart, and Lawson, and then print out the illustration on the Internet.
　No money will be exchanged.

It would be greatly appreciated if you could provide us with a PSD of the background and another transparency material.

■Image
We would like an illustration of a scene where you and your listeners are celebrating with a glass of wine.
We will leave the background to you. We have both new and old costumes, so please choose whichever you like best. (If it is too difficult, we can leave it to you to choose a party dress!)

(If it is too difficult, we can leave it to you to choose the party dress! (If it is too difficult, just the normal version is OK.)

I'm sorry for the length of this message, but thank you in advance for your cooperation.
